answer: New agents join only through a voucher who stakes 250 tokens per newcomer for 12 epochs, and if the newcomer is flagged as a duplicate the voucher loses the stake and its own anchor weight halves. Seeding 30 clones needs 30 x 250 = 7,500 tokens at risk, and one flag cascades up the vine. A dune of fresh keys has no root until someone real pays to vouch.
